en.B: Ahab said to Elijah, "Have you found me, my enemy?" "I have found you," Elijah answered, "because you have sold yourself to do what is evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Ahab said to Elijah, "So, my enemy, have you found me?" Elijah answered, "Yes, I have found you. You have given yourself over to doing what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says is evil.

es.L: Y Acab dijo a Elías: «¿Me has hallado, enemigo mío?». Y él dijo: «[Te] he hallado, porque te has vendido para hacer lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Acab le dijo a Elías: «¿Me has encontrado, enemigo mío?». «Te he encontrado», respondió Elías, «porque te has vendido para hacer lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Acab le dijo a Elías: «Así que, enemigo mío, ¿me has encontrado?». Elías respondió: «Sí, te he encontrado. Te has entregado a hacer lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba.

fr.L: Et Achab dit à Élie : « M’as-tu trouvé, mon ennemi ? » Et il dit : « Je [t’]ai trouvé, parce que tu t’es vendu pour faire ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Achab dit à Élie : « Tu m’as donc trouvé, mon ennemi ? » « Je t’ai trouvé, répondit Élie, parce que tu t’es vendu pour faire ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Achab a dit à Élie : « Alors, mon ennemi, tu m’as trouvé ? » Élie a répondu : « Oui, je t’ai trouvé. Tu t’es livré tout entier à faire ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais.

sw.L: Ahabu akamwambia Eliya, "Je, umenipata, adui yangu?" Akasema, "Nimekupata, kwa sababu umejiuza kufanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Ahabu akamwambia Eliya, "Je, umenipata, adui yangu?" Eliya akajibu, "Nimekupata, kwa sababu umejiuza kufanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Ahabu akamwambia Eliya, "Kumbe, adui yangu, umenipata?" Eliya akajibu, "Ndiyo, nimekupata. Umejitoa kabisa kufanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayoyaona kuwa mabaya.

vi.L: A-háp nói với Ê-li: "Hỡi kẻ thù của ta, ông đã tìm ra ta rồi sao?" Ông đáp: "Tôi đã tìm ra [vua], vì vua đã bán mình để làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: A-háp nói với Ê-li: "Hỡi kẻ thù của ta, ông đã tìm ra ta rồi sao?" Ê-li đáp: "Tôi đã tìm ra vua, vì vua đã bán mình để làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: A-háp nói với Ê-li: "Kẻ thù của ta ơi, ông đã tìm ra ta rồi sao?" Ê-li trả lời: "Phải, tôi đã tìm ra vua. Vua đã phó mình cho việc làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác.

ko.L: 그러자 아합이 엘리야에게 말했다. "내 원수야, 네가 나를 찾아냈느냐?" 그러자 그가 말했다. "찾아냈소. 당신이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 하려고 자기를 팔았기 때문이오.
ko.B: 아합이 엘리야에게 말했다. "내 원수야, 네가 나를 찾아냈느냐?" 엘리야가 대답했다. "그렇소, 찾아냈소. 당신이 자기 자신을 팔아 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했기 때문이오.
ko.R: 아합이 엘리야에게 말했다. "내 원수야, 결국 네가 나를 찾아냈구나!" 엘리야가 대답했다. "그렇소, 찾아냈소. 당신은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 하는 데 자기 자신을 내주었소.

decisions.choice: found: Ahab means "caught"; Elijah takes up the word
decisions.reason: Ahab feels caught in the act at the vineyard. Elijah answers with the same word: he has found Ahab because of what Ahab has done.

decisions.choice: my enemy: as Ahab once called Elijah "the troubler of Israel"
decisions.reason: Ahab sees the prophet as his personal foe (18:17), not as the bearer of Yahweh's word (compare 22:8).

decisions.choice: you have sold yourself: given yourself over completely, like a slave sold to a master
decisions.reason: The same is said of Ahab in verse 25 and of Israel in 2 Kings 17:17. Ahab is pictured as having handed himself over to evil as its property.

decisions.choice: Elijah's words: they run through verse 24
decisions.reason: Elijah's speech opens here and closes at the end of verse 24. In verses 21-22 Yahweh speaks in the first person through him.

decisions.choice: given yourself over to
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of selling oneself (m3).

decisions.choice: did the evil in the eyes of / what is evil in the sight of / what the LORD says is evil
decisions.reason: The verdict on the kings is worded as everywhere in Kings.

decisions.choice: "te has vendido" (L, B); "te has entregado" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the picture of selling oneself like a slave; Readable gives its sense, as the English does.

decisions.choice: umejiuza
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the picture of a man selling himself as a slave ("kujiuza"); Readable gives its sense, "kujitoa kabisa".

decisions.choice: "자기를 팔다" (L, B), "자기 자신을 내주다" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the picture of selling oneself as a slave to evil; Readable says it plainly, as the English does.

source.text: הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִ֤יא אֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ רָעָ֔ה וּבִעַרְתִּ֖י אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י לְאַחְאָב֙ מַשְׁתִּ֣ין בְּקִ֔יר וְעָצ֥וּר וְעָז֖וּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Behold, I [am] bringing to you evil, and I will burn away after you, and I will cut off to Ahab one urinating against a wall, and shut up and left in Israel.

en.L: Look, I am bringing disaster on you, and I will sweep away after you, and I will cut off from Ahab [every] one who urinates against a wall, bond and free, in Israel.
en.B: I am about to bring disaster on you. I will sweep away those who come after you, and I will cut off from Ahab every male in Israel, bond or free.
en.R: I will bring disaster on you. I will wipe out your family line. I will destroy every man and boy in Ahab's family in Israel, slave or free.

es.L: He aquí que yo traigo el mal sobre ti, y barreré tu descendencia, y cortaré de Acab a [todo] el que orina contra la pared, siervo y libre, en Israel.
es.B: Voy a traer desgracia sobre ti. Barreré a los que vengan después de ti, y exterminaré de Acab a todo varón en Israel, sea esclavo o libre.
es.R: Traeré desgracia sobre ti. Acabaré con tu descendencia. Destruiré a todos los hombres y niños de la familia de Acab en Israel, sean esclavos o libres.

fr.L: Voici, je vais faire venir sur toi le malheur, et je balaierai derrière toi, et je retrancherai d’Achab quiconque urine contre un mur, esclave ou libre en Israël.
fr.B: Je vais faire venir le malheur sur toi. Je balaierai ceux qui viendront après toi, et je retrancherai d’Achab tout homme en Israël, esclave ou libre.
fr.R: Je vais faire venir le malheur sur toi. Je ferai disparaître ta descendance. Je ferai mourir tous les hommes et tous les garçons de la famille d’Achab en Israël, esclaves ou libres.

sw.L: Tazama, mimi [ninaleta] maafa juu yako, nami nitakufagilia mbali nyuma yako, nami nitamkatilia mbali Ahabu kila akojoaye ukutani, aliyefungwa na aliyeachwa huru, katika Israeli.
sw.B: Nitaleta maafa juu yako. Nitawafagilia mbali wazao wako, nami nitamkatilia mbali Ahabu kila mwanamume katika Israeli, mtumwa au huru.
sw.R: Nitaleta maafa juu yako. Nitaiangamiza jamaa yako yote. Nitamwangamiza kila mwanamume na kila mvulana katika jamaa ya Ahabu katika Israeli, mtumwa au huru.

vi.L: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp giáng tai họa trên ngươi; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ quét sạch ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ diệt khỏi A-háp [mọi] kẻ đái vào tường, kẻ bị giam cũng như kẻ được tự do trong Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Ta sắp giáng tai họa trên ngươi. Ta sẽ quét sạch dòng dõi ngươi, và diệt khỏi A-háp mọi người nam trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, dù nô lệ hay tự do.
vi.R: Ta sẽ giáng tai họa trên ngươi. Ta sẽ xóa sạch dòng dõi ngươi. Ta sẽ tiêu diệt mọi người nam trong gia đình A-háp tại Y-sơ-ra-ên, dù là nô lệ hay người tự do.

ko.L: 보아라, 내가 너에게 재앙을 내리겠다. 내가 네 뒤를 쓸어 버리고, 아합에게서 벽에 소변을 보는 자를, 이스라엘에서 매인 자나 놓인 자나 [모두] 끊어 버리겠다.
ko.B: 내가 너에게 재앙을 내리겠다. 내가 네 자손을 쓸어 버리고, 이스라엘에서 아합에게 속한 남자는 종이든 자유인이든 모두 끊어 버리겠다.
ko.R: 내가 너에게 재앙을 내리겠다. 내가 네 집안의 대를 끊어 버리겠다. 이스라엘에 있는 아합 집안의 남자는 어른이든 아이든, 종이든 자유인이든 모두 없애 버리겠다.

decisions.choice: I: Yahweh speaking through Elijah
decisions.reason: Without a new introduction, Elijah speaks Yahweh's words in the first person, as prophets do. The words are not the ones given in verse 19 but the same judgment that Ahijah spoke against Jeroboam (14:10) and Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha (16:3-4).

decisions.choice: sweep away after you: destroy what is left of you, your line
decisions.reason: The verb is used of burning up or clearing out completely (14:10, "as one burns up dung"; 16:3). "After you" points to those who would come after Ahab, his descendants.

decisions.choice: one who urinates against a wall: a male
decisions.reason: The coarse phrase means every male, from the boy upward, as in 1 Samuel 25:22 and 14:10; 16:11.

decisions.choice: shut up and left: everyone, of every kind
decisions.reason: The pair is not certain. It may mean slave and free, those under restraint and those at liberty, or minors under care and adults. In every reading it means all without exception, as in 14:10 and Deuteronomy 32:36.

decisions.choice: bringing: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) lack the last letter of this word; the form marked to be read aloud (qere) is the usual spelling of "bringing". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: every male (Balanced); every man and boy (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the plain sense of the coarse idiom (m3), as in 1 Samuel 25:22; Literal keeps its picture. No gender setting is used, because only males are meant.

decisions.choice: bond and free (Literal); bond or free (Balanced); slave or free (Readable)
decisions.reason: Worded as at 14:10; the decision (m4) keeps the other possible senses.

decisions.choice: Elijah passes from his own "tôi" to the LORD's "Ta" and "ngươi" without a new quotation
decisions.reason: The Hebrew lets Yahweh speak through Elijah from here to verse 24, as the meaning decision notes; Vietnamese changes pronouns with the speaker.

decisions.choice: the LORD's words in verses 21-24 in 해라체 ("내가 너에게"), inside Elijah's 하오체 speech
decisions.reason: Here Elijah speaks the LORD's own words in the first person (the meaning decision); Korean gives them God's 해라체, as in the other oracles of the block.

source.text: וְנָתַתִּ֣י אֶת־בֵּיתְךָ֗ כְּבֵית֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־נְבָ֔ט וּכְבֵ֖ית בַּעְשָׁ֣א בֶן־אֲחִיָּ֑ה אֶל־הַכַּ֨עַס֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכְעַ֔סְתָּ וַֽתַּחֲטִ֖א אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will make your house like [the] house of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like [the] house of Baasha son of Ahijah, because of the provocation which you provoked, and you caused Israel to sin.

en.L: And I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like the house of Baasha son of Ahijah, because of the provocation with which you have provoked [{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}] and [because] you have made Israel sin.
en.B: I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like the house of Baasha son of Ahijah, because you have provoked {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to anger and have led Israel to sin.
en.R: I will do to your family what I did to the families of Jeroboam son of Nebat and of Baasha son of Ahijah. You have made {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} angry, and you have led Israel into sin.

es.L: Y haré tu casa como la casa de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat y como la casa de Baasa hijo de Ahías, por la provocación con que [{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}] has provocado y [porque] has hecho pecar a Israel».
es.B: Haré a tu casa como la casa de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat y como la casa de Baasa hijo de Ahías, porque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has provocado a ira y has hecho pecar a Israel».
es.R: Haré con tu familia lo que hice con las familias de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat y de Baasa hijo de Ahías. Me has hecho enojar, y has hecho pecar a Israel».

fr.L: Et je rendrai ta maison semblable à la maison de Jéroboam fils de Nebath et à la maison de Baésha fils d’Ahiya, à cause de la provocation par laquelle tu [{{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}]as irrité et [parce que] tu as fait pécher Israël.
fr.B: Je rendrai ta maison semblable à la maison de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, et à la maison de Baésha, fils d’Ahiya, parce que tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as irrité et que tu as entraîné Israël à pécher.
fr.R: Je ferai à ta famille ce que j’ai fait aux familles de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, et de Baésha, fils d’Ahiya. Tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as mis en colère, et tu as entraîné Israël dans le péché.

sw.L: Nami nitaifanya nyumba yako kama nyumba ya Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, na kama nyumba ya Baasha mwana wa Ahiya, kwa sababu ya uchokozi ulionichokoza, na [kwa sababu] umewafanya Israeli watende dhambi.
sw.B: Nitaifanya nyumba yako kama nyumba ya Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati na kama nyumba ya Baasha mwana wa Ahiya, kwa sababu umenikasirisha na kuwaongoza Israeli kutenda dhambi.
sw.R: Nitaitendea jamaa yako kama nilivyozitendea jamaa za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati na Baasha mwana wa Ahiya. Umenikasirisha, nawe umewaongoza Israeli kutenda dhambi.

vi.L: Ta sẽ làm cho nhà ngươi giống như nhà Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát và như nhà Ba-ê-sa con trai A-hi-gia, vì sự chọc giận mà ngươi đã chọc giận [{{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}], và [vì] ngươi đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm tội.
vi.B: Ta sẽ làm cho nhà ngươi giống như nhà Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát và nhà Ba-ê-sa con trai A-hi-gia, vì ngươi đã chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm tội.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm cho gia đình ngươi như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho gia đình Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát và gia đình Ba-ê-sa con trai A-hi-gia. Ngươi đã làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nổi giận, và ngươi đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm tội.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 네 집을 느밧의 아들 여로보암의 집과 아히야의 아들 바아사의 집처럼 만들겠다. 네가 [나를] 노엽게 한 그 노엽게 함 때문이고, [네가] 이스라엘에게 죄를 짓게 했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 내가 네 집안을 느밧의 아들 여로보암의 집안과 아히야의 아들 바아사의 집안처럼 만들겠다. 네가 나를 노엽게 하고 이스라엘에게 죄를 짓게 했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 내가 느밧의 아들 여로보암의 집안과 아히야의 아들 바아사의 집안에 한 것처럼 네 집안에도 하겠다. 너는 나를 화나게 했고, 이스라엘에게 죄를 짓게 했다.

decisions.choice: the house of Jeroboam, the house of Baasha: two royal families wiped out
decisions.reason: Baasha killed the whole family of Jeroboam (15:29), and Zimri killed the whole family of Baasha (16:11-12), as the prophets had said (14:10-11; 16:3-4). Ahab's line will end the same way.

decisions.choice: your house: your family line, your dynasty
decisions.reason: "House" means the royal family, as with Jeroboam and Baasha.

decisions.choice: provoked: Yahweh is the one provoked
decisions.reason: The verb has no object written, but the formula always means provoking Yahweh to anger (15:30; 16:2, 7, 13).

decisions.choice: me
decisions.reason: The object of "provoked" is supplied (m3), in brackets at Literal.

decisions.choice: I will do to your family what I did to
decisions.reason: Readable states the comparison as an action, which says the same thing in plainer words.

decisions.choice: made Israel sin / led Israel to sin / led Israel into sin; provoked to anger / made angry
decisions.reason: The formulas worded as at 14:9 and 14:16, here said of Ahab.

decisions.choice: ulionichokoza; umenikasirisha (no span)
decisions.reason: The English supplies "me" with a span; Swahili has it as the object marker "-ni-" in the verb, which takes no span, and needs no bracket at Literal.

source.text: וְגַ֨ם־לְאִיזֶ֔בֶל דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הַכְּלָבִ֛ים יֹאכְל֥וּ אֶת־אִיזֶ֖בֶל בְּחֵ֥ל יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃

records.literal_gloss: And also of Jezebel spoke Yahweh, saying, The dogs will eat Jezebel in [the] rampart of Jezreel.

en.L: And also concerning Jezebel {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken, saying, 'The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.'
en.B: And concerning Jezebel {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has also spoken: 'The dogs will eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.'
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has also said this about Jezebel: 'Dogs will eat Jezebel by the city wall of Jezreel.'

es.L: Y también de Jezabel ha hablado {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, diciendo: “Los perros comerán a Jezabel junto al antemuro de Jezreel”.
es.B: Y acerca de Jezabel también ha hablado {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: “Los perros se comerán a Jezabel junto al muro de Jezreel”.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} también ha dicho esto acerca de Jezabel: “Los perros se comerán a Jezabel junto a la muralla de Jezreel”.

fr.L: Et au sujet de Jézabel aussi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a parlé, en disant : “Les chiens mangeront Jézabel près du rempart de Jizreël.”
fr.B: Au sujet de Jézabel aussi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a parlé : “Les chiens mangeront Jézabel près de la muraille de Jizreël.”
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a aussi dit ceci au sujet de Jézabel : “Des chiens mangeront Jézabel près de la muraille de Jizreël.”

sw.L: Tena kuhusu Yezebeli {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema, akisema, 'Mbwa watamla Yezebeli karibu na boma la Yezreeli.'
sw.B: Tena kuhusu Yezebeli {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema: 'Mbwa watamla Yezebeli karibu na ukuta wa Yezreeli.'
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema pia hivi kuhusu Yezebeli: 'Mbwa watamla Yezebeli karibu na ukuta wa mji wa Yezreeli.'

vi.L: Về Giê-sa-bên, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cũng đã phán rằng: 'Chó sẽ ăn thịt Giê-sa-bên bên lũy thành Gít-rê-ên.'
vi.B: Về Giê-sa-bên, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cũng đã phán: 'Chó sẽ ăn thịt Giê-sa-bên bên tường thành Gít-rê-ên.'
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cũng đã phán về Giê-sa-bên: 'Chó sẽ ăn thịt Giê-sa-bên bên tường thành Gít-rê-ên.'

ko.L: 그리고 이세벨에 대해서도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. '개들이 이스르엘 성벽 곁에서 이세벨을 먹을 것이다.'
ko.B: 또 이세벨에 대해서도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. '개들이 이스르엘 성벽 곁에서 이세벨을 먹을 것이다.'
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이세벨에 대해서도 말씀하셨다. '개들이 이스르엘 성벽 곁에서 이세벨을 먹을 것이다.'

decisions.choice: rampart: the outer wall or bank of the town
decisions.reason: The word means the outer defenses of a city. Some Hebrew manuscripts and ancient translations read a very similar word, "plot of ground", as in 2 Kings 9:10, 36-37 ("in the plot of ground of Jezreel"). The standard Hebrew text is followed.

decisions.choice: the dogs will eat Jezebel: fulfilled when Jehu came to Jezreel
decisions.reason: Jezebel was thrown from a window at Jezreel, and when men went to bury her, the dogs had left only her skull, feet and hands (2 Kings 9:30-37).

decisions.choice: dogs eating a body: the worst disgrace
decisions.reason: Dogs in ancient towns were scavengers. To lie unburied and be eaten by them was the deepest shame (compare Deuteronomy 28:26).

decisions.choice: wall (Balanced); city wall (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Rampart" is less familiar; Balanced and Readable say "wall".

source.text: הַמֵּ֤ת לְאַחְאָב֙ בָּעִ֔יר יֹאכְל֖וּ הַכְּלָבִ֑ים וְהַמֵּת֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה יֹאכְל֖וּ ע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: The [one] dying of Ahab in the city, will eat the dogs; and the [one] dying in the field, will eat [the] birds of the heavens.

en.L: The one belonging to Ahab who dies in the city, the dogs will eat; and the one who dies in the field, the birds of the heavens will eat."
en.B: Anyone belonging to Ahab who dies in the city, the dogs will eat, and anyone who dies in the open country, the birds of the sky will eat."
en.R: Dogs will eat anyone in Ahab's family who dies in the city, and birds will eat anyone who dies out in the country."

es.L: Al que de Acab muera en la ciudad, se lo comerán los perros; y al que muera en el campo, se lo comerán las aves de los cielos».
es.B: A cualquiera de los de Acab que muera en la ciudad, se lo comerán los perros, y al que muera en el campo, se lo comerán las aves del cielo».
es.R: Los perros se comerán a cualquiera de la familia de Acab que muera en la ciudad, y las aves se comerán a cualquiera que muera en el campo».

fr.L: Celui d’Achab qui mourra dans la ville, les chiens le mangeront ; et celui qui mourra dans les champs, les oiseaux du ciel le mangeront. »
fr.B: Tout homme d’Achab qui mourra dans la ville sera mangé par les chiens, et celui qui mourra dans la campagne sera mangé par les oiseaux du ciel. »
fr.R: Les chiens mangeront ceux de la famille d’Achab qui mourront en ville, et les oiseaux mangeront ceux qui mourront dans la campagne. »

sw.L: Aliye wa Ahabu atakayekufa mjini, mbwa watamla; naye atakayekufa shambani, ndege wa angani watamla."
sw.B: Yeyote wa Ahabu atakayekufa mjini, mbwa watamla, na yeyote atakayekufa nyikani, ndege wa angani watamla."
sw.R: Mbwa watamla yeyote wa jamaa ya Ahabu atakayekufa mjini, na ndege watamla yeyote atakayekufa porini."

vi.L: Kẻ thuộc về A-háp chết trong thành, chó sẽ ăn; và kẻ chết ngoài đồng, chim trời sẽ ăn."
vi.B: Ai thuộc nhà A-háp chết trong thành sẽ bị chó ăn, ai chết ngoài đồng sẽ bị chim trời ăn."
vi.R: Người nào trong gia đình A-háp chết trong thành sẽ bị chó ăn, người nào chết ngoài đồng sẽ bị chim ăn."

ko.L: 아합에게 속한 자로서 성읍에서 죽는 자는 개들이 먹고, 들에서 죽는 자는 하늘의 새들이 먹을 것이다."
ko.B: 아합에게 속한 사람이 성읍에서 죽으면 개들이 먹고, 들에서 죽으면 공중의 새들이 먹을 것이다."
ko.R: 아합 집안 사람이 성 안에서 죽으면 개들이 먹고, 들에서 죽으면 새들이 먹을 것이다."

decisions.choice: the dogs will eat, the birds will eat: the same curse as on Jeroboam and Baasha
decisions.reason: The words are those spoken against the house of Jeroboam (14:11) and the house of Baasha (16:4). None of Ahab's family will receive a proper burial.

decisions.choice: the field: open country outside the town
decisions.reason: "Field" here means the countryside, set against the city: wherever they die, they will not be buried.

decisions.choice: Dogs will eat anyone in Ahab's family
decisions.reason: Readable puts the subject first; Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew order, which puts those who die first. Each level words the sentence as at 14:11 and 16:4.

source.text: רַ֚ק לֹֽא־הָיָ֣ה כְאַחְאָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִתְמַכֵּ֔ר לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־הֵסַ֥תָּה אֹת֖וֹ אִיזֶ֥בֶל אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Surely not was like Ahab, who sold himself to do the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, whom incited him Jezebel his wife.

en.L: Indeed, there was none like Ahab, who sold himself to do the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, whom Jezebel his wife incited.
en.B: There was truly no one like Ahab, who sold himself to do what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, urged on by his wife Jezebel.
en.R: There was never anyone like Ahab. He gave himself over to doing what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil, and his wife Jezebel urged him on.

es.L: Ciertamente no hubo nadie como Acab, que se vendió para hacer lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque Jezabel su mujer lo incitaba.
es.B: En verdad no hubo nadie como Acab, que se vendió para hacer lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, incitado por su esposa Jezabel.
es.R: Nunca hubo nadie como Acab. Se entregó a hacer lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba, y su esposa Jezabel lo animaba a hacerlo.

fr.L: Vraiment, il n’y eut personne comme Achab, qui se vendit pour faire ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et que Jézabel sa femme excitait.
fr.B: Il n’y eut vraiment personne comme Achab, qui se vendit pour faire ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, poussé par sa femme Jézabel.
fr.R: Il n’y a jamais eu personne comme Achab. Il s’est livré tout entier à faire ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais, et sa femme Jézabel l’y poussait.

sw.L: Hakika hapakuwa na mtu kama Ahabu, aliyejiuza kufanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambaye Yezebeli mkewe alimchochea.
sw.B: Kwa kweli hapakuwa na mtu kama Ahabu, aliyejiuza kufanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akichochewa na mkewe Yezebeli.
sw.R: Hapakuwa kamwe na mtu kama Ahabu. Alijitoa kabisa kufanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya, naye Yezebeli mkewe akamchochea.

vi.L: Thật vậy, không có ai giống như A-háp, là người đã bán mình để làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì Giê-sa-bên vợ ông xúi giục ông.
vi.B: Thật chẳng có ai như A-háp, là người đã bán mình để làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, do Giê-sa-bên vợ vua xúi giục.
vi.R: Chưa bao giờ có ai như A-háp. Vua đã phó mình cho việc làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác, và Giê-sa-bên vợ vua đã xúi giục vua.

ko.L: 참으로 아합처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 하려고 자기를 판 자가 없었으니, 그의 아내 이세벨이 그를 부추겼다.
ko.B: 아합처럼 자기 자신을 팔아 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 한 사람은 정말 없었다. 그의 아내 이세벨이 그를 부추겼기 때문이다.
ko.R: 아합 같은 사람은 이제까지 한 번도 없었다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 하는 데 자기 자신을 내주었다. 그의 아내 이세벨이 그를 부추겼다.

decisions.choice: indeed: the narrator's own comment
decisions.reason: Verses 25-26 break into the story to give the writer's verdict on Ahab; the story resumes in verse 27.

decisions.choice: sold himself: gave himself over completely
decisions.reason: As in verse 20.

decisions.choice: incited: stirred up, lured
decisions.reason: The verb is used of enticing someone to wrong, as of one who would lure a family member to serve other gods (Deuteronomy 13:7). Jezebel urged Ahab on, but the verse still holds him responsible.

decisions.choice: gave himself over to
decisions.reason: As in verse 20.

source.text: וַיַּתְעֵ֣ב מְאֹ֔ד לָלֶ֖כֶת אַחֲרֵ֣י הַגִּלֻּלִ֑ים כְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֣וּ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he acted abominably exceedingly, to walk after the idols, according to all that did the Amorite[s] whom dispossessed Yahweh from before [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And he acted very abominably in going after the idols, according to all that the Amorites had done, whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} drove out before the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: He acted in the most detestable way by going after idols, just as the Amorites had done, whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} drove out before the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: He did horrible things. He worshiped idols, just as the Amorites had done. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} had forced the Amorites out of the land to make room for the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

es.L: E hizo cosas muy abominables, yendo tras los ídolos, conforme a todo lo que hicieron los amorreos, a quienes {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} expulsó de delante de los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Actuó de la manera más detestable, yendo tras los ídolos, tal como habían hecho los amorreos, a quienes {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} expulsó delante de los israelitas.
es.R: Hizo cosas horribles. Adoró ídolos, tal como lo habían hecho los amorreos. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había expulsado a los amorreos de la tierra para dejar lugar a los israelitas.

fr.L: Et il agit de façon tout à fait abominable en marchant derrière les idoles, selon tout ce qu’avaient fait les Amorites, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait chassés devant les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: Il se conduisit de la façon la plus odieuse en suivant les idoles, comme l’avaient fait les Amorites, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait chassés devant les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.
fr.R: Il a fait des choses horribles. Il a adoré des idoles, comme l’avaient fait les Amorites. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait chassé les Amorites du pays pour faire de la place aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.

sw.L: Akafanya machukizo mengi sana kwa kuzifuata sanamu, sawasawa na yote waliyofanya Waamori, ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwafukuza mbele ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Alitenda kwa namna ya kuchukiza mno kwa kuzifuata sanamu, kama walivyofanya Waamori, ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwafukuza mbele ya Waisraeli.
sw.R: Alifanya mambo ya kuchukiza sana. Aliziabudu sanamu, kama Waamori walivyofanya. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amewafukuza Waamori kutoka katika nchi ili kuwapa Waisraeli nafasi.

vi.L: Ông đã làm điều rất ghê tởm khi đi theo các thần tượng, theo mọi điều người A-mô-rít đã làm, là dân mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi khỏi trước mặt con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Vua đã làm những điều hết sức ghê tởm khi đi theo các thần tượng, y như người A-mô-rít đã làm, là dân mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi đi trước mặt dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Vua đã làm những điều kinh tởm. Vua thờ lạy các thần tượng, y như người A-mô-rít đã làm. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi người A-mô-rít ra khỏi xứ để dành chỗ cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 우상들을 따라가는 데 매우 가증하게 행했으니, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손 앞에서 쫓아내신 아모리 사람들이 행한 모든 것과 같았다.
ko.B: 그는 우상들을 따라가 가장 역겨운 짓을 했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손 앞에서 쫓아내신 아모리 사람들이 한 것과 똑같았다.
ko.R: 그는 아주 역겨운 일들을 했다. 그는 우상들을 섬겼는데, 아모리 사람들이 한 것과 똑같았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이스라엘 자손이 그 땅에서 살 수 있도록 아모리 사람들을 쫓아내셨었다.

decisions.choice: idols: a scornful word for false gods
decisions.reason: The word is used in contempt (Leviticus 26:30; Deuteronomy 29:16). It may be related to a word for dung, though its origin is not certain.

decisions.choice: the Amorites: here, all the peoples of Canaan before Israel
decisions.reason: "Amorites" can stand for all the nations who lived in the land before Israel (Genesis 15:16; 2 Kings 21:11).

decisions.choice: whom Yahweh drove out: Ahab brings back the ways of the nations Yahweh removed
decisions.reason: The nations lost the land because of such practices (Leviticus 18:24-28). By following them, Ahab puts Israel in the same danger.

decisions.choice: going after: following as worshipers
decisions.reason: To "walk after" a god means to serve and worship it (Deuteronomy 6:14).

decisions.choice: worshiped idols
decisions.reason: Readable gives the meaning of "going after" (m4).

decisions.choice: out of the land to make room for
decisions.reason: Readable spells out what "drove out before" Israel meant.

decisions.choice: "los amorreos"
decisions.reason: The form of the Spanish of 2 Samuel 21.

source.text: וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ אַחְאָ֜ב אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֤ים הָאֵ֨לֶּה֙ וַיִּקְרַ֣ע בְּגָדָ֔יו וַיָּֽשֶׂם־שַׂ֥ק עַל־בְּשָׂר֖וֹ וַיָּצ֑וֹם וַיִּשְׁכַּ֣ב בַּשָּׂ֔ק וַיְהַלֵּ֖ךְ אַֽט׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And it was, as heard Ahab the words the these, and he tore his clothes and put sackcloth on his flesh and fasted, and he lay in the sackcloth and went about softly.

en.L: And it happened, when Ahab heard these words, he tore his clothes and put sackcloth on his flesh and fasted, and he lay in the sackcloth and went about softly.
en.B: When Ahab heard these words, he tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his body, and fasted. He lay down in sackcloth and went about quietly.
en.R: When Ahab heard this message, he tore his clothes and put on sackcloth, the rough cloth people wore to show grief or sorrow. He did not eat. He even slept in the sackcloth, and he went around quietly and sadly.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando Acab oyó estas palabras, rasgó sus vestidos y puso cilicio sobre su carne y ayunó, y se acostaba con el cilicio y andaba humillado.
es.B: Cuando Acab oyó estas palabras, rasgó sus vestidos, se puso cilicio sobre el cuerpo y ayunó. Se acostaba con el cilicio puesto y andaba abatido.
es.R: Cuando Acab oyó este mensaje, rasgó su ropa y se puso cilicio, la tela áspera que la gente se ponía para mostrar dolor o tristeza. No comía nada. Hasta dormía con el cilicio puesto, y andaba callado y triste.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand Achab entendit ces paroles, qu’il déchira ses vêtements, mit un sac sur sa chair et jeûna ; et il se coucha avec le sac, et il marchait lentement.
fr.B: Quand Achab entendit ces paroles, il déchira ses vêtements, mit un sac sur son corps et jeûna. Il se couchait avec le sac et marchait à pas lents.
fr.R: Quand Achab a entendu ce message, il a déchiré ses vêtements et il a mis un sac, la toile grossière qu’on portait pour montrer son chagrin. Il ne mangeait plus. Il dormait même dans ce sac, et il marchait sans bruit, tristement.

sw.L: Ikawa, Ahabu aliposikia maneno haya, akararua mavazi yake, akavaa gunia mwilini mwake, akafunga; akalala katika gunia, akaenda polepole.
sw.B: Ahabu aliposikia maneno hayo, alirarua mavazi yake, akavaa gunia mwilini, akafunga. Akalala akiwa amevaa gunia, akatembea kwa unyonge.
sw.R: Ahabu aliposikia ujumbe huo, alirarua nguo zake, akavaa gunia, nguo ya kukwaruza ambayo watu walivaa kuonyesha huzuni au toba. Hakula chakula. Hata alilala akiwa amevaa gunia, akatembea kimya kwa huzuni.

vi.L: Xảy ra, khi A-háp nghe những lời này, ông xé áo mình, quấn vải thô trên thân mình và kiêng ăn; ông nằm trong vải thô và đi đứng ủ rũ.
vi.B: Khi A-háp nghe những lời ấy, vua xé áo mình, mặc vải thô sát thân và kiêng ăn. Vua nằm trong vải thô và đi đứng lặng lẽ.
vi.R: Khi A-háp nghe sứ điệp ấy, vua xé áo mình và mặc vải thô, là loại vải người ta mặc để tỏ lòng đau buồn hay ăn năn. Vua không ăn uống gì. Vua còn mặc vải thô mà ngủ, và đi đứng lặng lẽ, buồn rầu.

ko.L: 그리고 아합이 이 말들을 들었을 때, 그는 자기 옷을 찢고 자기 몸에 굵은 베를 걸치고 금식했다. 그리고 그는 굵은 베를 깔고 누웠고 풀이 죽어 다녔다.
ko.B: 아합은 이 말을 듣고 자기 옷을 찢고 맨몸에 굵은 베를 걸치고 금식했다. 그는 굵은 베를 입은 채로 누웠고, 풀이 죽어 조용히 다녔다.
ko.R: 아합은 이 말을 듣고 자기 옷을 찢었다. 그리고 굵은 베옷을 입었다. 굵은 베는 슬픔을 나타내려고 입는 거친 천이었다. 그는 아무것도 먹지 않았다. 잠잘 때도 굵은 베옷을 입었고, 슬픈 모습으로 조용히 다녔다.

decisions.choice: tore his clothes, sackcloth, fasting: signs of grief and repentance
decisions.reason: These were the outward signs of mourning and of turning from sin (Genesis 37:34; 2 Samuel 3:31; Jonah 3:5-8). The fast that Jezebel proclaimed to cover a crime (verse 9) is now kept by Ahab in sorrow.

decisions.choice: softly: slowly, quietly, in a subdued way
decisions.reason: The word means gently or slowly (Isaiah 8:6). It describes a man who goes about humbled and downcast.

decisions.choice: his flesh: his body, next to the skin
decisions.reason: "Flesh" means the body itself: he wore the sackcloth against his skin.

decisions.choice: the rough cloth people wore to show grief or sorrow
decisions.reason: Readable explains sackcloth, as at 2 Samuel 21:10.

decisions.choice: "andaba humillado" (L); "andaba abatido" (B); "callado y triste" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means going softly, slowly; Spanish gives the bearing it shows at each level, as the English "softly" and "quietly" do.

decisions.choice: "굵은 베" at every level; Readable explains it
decisions.reason: The Samuel terms note's word for sackcloth; Readable adds what it was for, as the English does.

records.literal_gloss: And came [the] word of Yahweh to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

source.text: הֲֽרָאִ֔יתָ כִּֽי־נִכְנַ֥ע אַחְאָ֖ב מִלְּפָנָ֑י יַ֜עַן כִּֽי־נִכְנַ֣ע מִפָּנַ֗י לֹֽא־אָבִ֤יא הָֽרָעָה֙ בְּיָמָ֔יו בִּימֵ֣י בְנ֔וֹ אָבִ֥יא הָרָעָ֖ה עַל־בֵּיתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Have you seen that has humbled himself Ahab from before me? Because that he has humbled himself from before me, not I will bring the evil in his days; in [the] days of his son I will bring the evil on his house.

en.L: "Have you seen how Ahab has humbled himself before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? Because he has humbled himself before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I will not bring the disaster in his days; in the days of his son I will bring the disaster on his house."
en.B: "Have you noticed how Ahab has humbled himself before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? Since he has humbled himself before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I will not bring the disaster during his lifetime. I will bring the disaster on his house in his son's days."
en.R: "Do you see how Ahab has made himself humble before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? Because he has done this, I will not bring the disaster while he is alive. I will bring it on his family when his son is king."

es.L: «¿Has visto cómo Acab se ha humillado delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}? Por cuanto se ha humillado delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, no traeré el mal en sus días; en los días de su hijo traeré el mal sobre su casa».
es.B: «¿Has notado cómo Acab se ha humillado delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}? Ya que se ha humillado delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, no traeré la desgracia mientras él viva. Traeré la desgracia sobre su casa en los días de su hijo».
es.R: «¿Ves cómo Acab se ha humillado delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}? Por haber hecho esto, no traeré la desgracia mientras él viva. La traeré sobre su familia cuando su hijo sea rey».

fr.L: « As-tu vu comment Achab s’est humilié devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ? Parce qu’il s’est humilié devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je ne ferai pas venir le malheur de son vivant ; c’est aux jours de son fils que je ferai venir le malheur sur sa maison. »
fr.B: « As-tu remarqué comment Achab s’est humilié devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ? Puisqu’il s’est humilié devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je ne ferai pas venir le malheur de son vivant. Je ferai venir le malheur sur sa maison au temps de son fils. »
fr.R: « Tu vois comment Achab s’est fait humble devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ? Parce qu’il a fait cela, je ne ferai pas venir le malheur pendant sa vie. Je le ferai venir sur sa famille quand son fils sera roi. »

sw.L: "Je, umeona jinsi Ahabu alivyojinyenyekeza mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}? Kwa sababu amejinyenyekeza mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, sitaleta maafa katika siku zake; katika siku za mwanawe nitaleta maafa juu ya nyumba yake."
sw.B: "Je, umeona jinsi Ahabu alivyojinyenyekeza mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}? Kwa kuwa amejinyenyekeza mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, sitaleta maafa wakati wa uhai wake. Nitaleta maafa juu ya nyumba yake katika siku za mwanawe."
sw.R: "Je, unaona jinsi Ahabu alivyojinyenyekeza mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}? Kwa sababu amefanya hivyo, sitaleta maafa wakati yeye yu hai. Nitaileta juu ya jamaa yake wakati mwanawe atakapokuwa mfalme."

vi.L: "Ngươi có thấy A-háp đã hạ mình trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không? Vì nó đã hạ mình trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không giáng tai họa trong đời nó; trong đời con trai nó, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giáng tai họa trên nhà nó."
vi.B: "Con có thấy A-háp đã hạ mình trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không? Vì nó đã hạ mình trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không giáng tai họa trong đời nó. Ta sẽ giáng tai họa trên nhà nó trong đời con trai nó."
vi.R: "Con có thấy A-háp đã hạ mình trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không? Vì nó đã làm như vậy, nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không giáng tai họa khi nó còn sống. Ta sẽ giáng tai họa trên gia đình nó khi con trai nó làm vua."

ko.L: "너는 아합이 내 앞에서 자기를 낮춘 것을 보았느냐? 그가 내 앞에서 자기를 낮추었으므로, 내가 그의 시대에는 그 재앙을 내리지 않겠다. 그의 아들의 시대에 내가 그의 집에 그 재앙을 내리겠다."
ko.B: "아합이 내 앞에서 얼마나 자기를 낮추었는지 보았느냐? 그가 내 앞에서 자기를 낮추었으니, 그가 살아 있는 동안에는 그 재앙을 내리지 않겠다. 그의 아들 대에 가서 그의 집안에 그 재앙을 내리겠다."
ko.R: "아합이 내 앞에서 얼마나 겸손해졌는지 보았느냐? 그가 이렇게 했으니, 그가 살아 있는 동안에는 재앙을 내리지 않겠다. 그의 아들이 왕이 되었을 때 그의 집안에 재앙을 내리겠다."

decisions.choice: Ahab has humbled himself: Yahweh answers even Ahab's repentance
decisions.reason: Yahweh takes note of the humbling of the worst of kings and responds to it, as he later did for Josiah (2 Kings 22:19-20) and for Nineveh (Jonah 3:10). The judgment is put off, not cancelled.

decisions.choice: in the days of his son: fulfilled under Joram
decisions.reason: Ahab's son Joram was killed by Jehu, his body was thrown onto Naboth's plot of ground, and Ahab's seventy sons were killed (2 Kings 9:24-26; 10:1-11).

decisions.choice: I will bring: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: As in verse 21, the written consonants (ketiv) lack the last letter of this verb; the form marked to be read aloud (qere) is the usual spelling. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: the disaster: the one already announced
decisions.reason: The article points back to the disaster of verse 21.

decisions.choice: when his son is king
decisions.reason: Readable explains "in the days of his son".

decisions.choice: mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}
decisions.reason: God's "before me" is "mbele yangu", whose free possessive takes the span, as the style guide sets.
